about: Gated checks in the player's format (player/README.md), for tools/player/build_parts.py --checks. Each check opens at the end of its scene (afterScene); build_parts.py fills in at and sceneStart from the measured timeline. say is the spoken question as shown under "Show the words"; ask and correct are the question and confirmation audio, and a probe's audio is its spoken follow-up, all relative to the project's player folder. A check is a single choice, or own_words (kept, never marked), then one probe (a scripted follow-up asking for a reason), then a choice: only a right choice shows Continue. Write the questions from the fixed script. A question you write stays a draft until it is explicitly approved. These checks belong to kit/templates/script/manifest.example.json.

voice.voice: the voice the question audio was recorded in
